title: Rainbow Islands
source: Achievements ported from c64-cheevos by hayesmaker (MIT), https://github.com/hayesmaker/c64-cheevos

achievements.title: Pot of Gold
achievements.description: Score 250,000 points.

achievements.title: Big Food
achievements.description: Score 500,000 points.

achievements.title: Big Whoop
achievements.description: Score 1 million points.

achievements.title: Bug Spray
achievements.description: Clear Island 1, Insect Island.

achievements.title: Helikopter Helikopter
achievements.description: Clear Island 2, Combat Island.

achievements.title: Do the Mash
achievements.description: Clear Island 3, Monster Island.

achievements.title: Toy Story
achievements.description: Clear Island 4, Toy Island.

achievements.title: Revenge on DOH!
achievements.description: Clear Island 5, Doh Island.

achievements.title: The Droids You're Looking For?
achievements.description: Clear Island 6, Robot Island.

achievements.title: End of the Rainbow!
achievements.description: Clear Island 7, Dragon Island, and beat the game.

achievements.title: The 1CC!
achievements.description: Complete the game on 1 credit.

achievements.title: Need For Speed
achievements.description: Collect the permanent boots upgrade.

achievements.title: Red Potion Mastery
achievements.description: Collect the secret red potion for the permanent double rainbows upgrade.

achievements.title: Yellow Potion Mastery
achievements.description: Collect the secret yellow potion for the permanent yellow potion upgrade.

achievements.title: Redbull
achievements.description: Collect the Book of Wings for the permanent wings upgrade.

achievements.title: Shilver Door
achievements.description: Go through the shilver door to warp directly to Dragon Island.

achievements.title: Birds of a Feather
achievements.description: Collect the secret feathers for the permanent fairy protection upgrade.

achievements.title: Coin Op
achievements.description: Complete the final level perfectly and collect the secret in the final boss room.

achievements.title: Rainbow Veteran
achievements.description: Collect 2 permanent upgrades in a single playthrough.

achievements.title: Rainbow Elite
achievements.description: Collect 3 permanent upgrades in a single playthrough.

achievements.title: Rainbow Ultimate Master
achievements.description: Collect 4 permanent upgrades in a single playthrough.

achievements.title: Good Ending
achievements.description: Collect 7 Big Diamonds and rescue the townsfolk.

achievements.title: Perfect Collection
achievements.description: Collect all diamonds in the correct order on Insect Island.

achievements.title: Wings of Death
achievements.description: Die while in possession of the wings power-up.
